principle: Revenue is recognized when the approved contract-control policy says control transfers. Incoterms, shipment completion, invoice creation, customs documents and document dispatch are evidence inputs; none is treated as a universal accounting trigger by itself.

CFR.expectedEvidence: Final B/L shipped-on-board date plus contract-control review

CIF.expectedEvidence: Final B/L shipped-on-board date plus contract-control review

CUSTOMER_EXPORT_SALE.costOfSales: Must be paired/reconciled to finished-goods inventory cost before period close.

TG_PAKISTAN_INTERCOMPANY.rule: Never derive the Pakistan-to-TG value or TG margin from the TG customer selling price.

periodCloseBlocks: Completed export lots with no recognition decision
Recognized export revenue with unresolved functional-currency translation
Recognized export revenue whose cost-of-sales / inventory-cost posting is still unresolved
TG-linked shipments where the Pakistan and TG intercompany sides do not reconcile
